You led us right to King Ommin's subterranean fortress.''"
"''And right to the heart of King Ommin's power!|Ulic Qel-Droma and King Ommin|audio=OmminsFortress-TotJ.flac|[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]}} Deep beneath the surface of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] was the '''subterranean fortress''' of '''King Ommin'''. Following the defeat of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Amanoa]] during the [[battle of Iziz]] in [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ommin/Legends|Ommin]] retreated to his fortress where he remained for the next two years, secretly planning to retake Onderon from the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] who had assisted the [[Beast Rider army]] in overthrowing Ommin's late [[Marriage/Legends|wife]]. The fortress was inadvertently discovered by Beast Rider [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Gobee]] and another soldier during a reconnaissance mission through Iziz's undercity. Ommin's fortress was subsequently destroyed during the [[Second Battle of Onderon|second battle]] of the [[Freedon Nadd Uprising|Naddist Uprising]], which culminated with Ommin's death at the hands of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]]. {{Loc-stub}} ==Appearances== *[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]] *[[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising'' 1]] {{1st}} *[[Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising'' 2]] ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Onderon locations]]
